        <div class="row clearfix">
            <div class="column full">
                <h1>Donate</h1>
                
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <section class='page_content'>
        <div class='container'>
            <div class='row clearfix'>
                <div class='column full'>
                    <p>Donating money to the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project is easy and important as it allows the
project&nbsp;sustainability.</p>
<h2 id="fund-core-team-developers-directly">Fund Core Team Developers Directly<a class="headerlink" href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>While we don&#8217;t raise funds to sponsor development as an organization yet, we encourage contributor&nbsp;fundraisers:</p>
<p class='buttons'>
  <a href="https://www.patreon.com/pippin">
    <span class='donate-button'>
      Fund Øyvind Kolås<sup>1</sup><br/>
      <strong><span class="caps">GEGL</span> development</strong>
    </span>
  </a>
  <a href="https://www.patreon.com/zemarmot">
    <span class='donate-button'>
      Fund ZeMarmot<sup>2</sup><br/>
      <strong><span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;development</strong>
    </span>
  </a>
</p>

<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Øyvind Kolås</strong> <a href="https://www.patreon.com/pippin">raises funds</a> for his work on <a href="http://gegl.org/"><span class="caps">GEGL</span></a>, <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&#8217;s new sophisticated image processing core. This work is crucial to implement features such as non-destructive editing in <span class="caps">GIMP</span>, including features known as adjustment layers and layer effects in similar software. Øyvind is the <span class="caps">GEGL</span> maintainer and its primary developer who has been working on it since&nbsp;mid-2000s.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Aryeom and Jehan</strong> <a href="https://www.patreon.com/zemarmot">raise funds</a> for <span class="caps">GIMP</span> development and a <span class="caps">GIMP</span>-powered animated movie: <strong>ZeMarmot</strong> (Libre Art, Creative Commons by-sa 4.0 licenses). The funds allow developing features for professional graphics usage and keeping <span class="caps">GIMP</span> bug-free. Jehan is a <span class="caps">GIMP</span> maintainer and has been one of its most active contributors since 2012, while Aryeom designs and tests features in production ever since, in a professional&nbsp;context.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="donate-to-the-project">Donate to the Project<a class="headerlink" href="#donate-to-the-project" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>The <a href="https://www.gnome.org/"><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation</a> has graciously agreed to act as fiscal agents for us. Contributions to the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project can be made by donating to the <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation and specifying the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project as the recipient. The <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation is a tax-exempt, non-profit 501(c)(3) organization and all donations are tax-deductible in the <span class="caps">USA</span>.</p>
<p>So far <strong>donation through <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation can only be used for community needs</strong> (conferences, developer meetings… see <a href="#donation-usage">below</a>) and material renewal. <a href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly">If you would rather fund paid development, favour Core Team developer funding above</a>.</p>
<p>You can choose from several options to support <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;financially:</p>
<div class="toc">
<ul>
<li><a href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly">Fund Core Team Developers&nbsp;Directly</a></li>
<li><a href="#donate-to-the-project">Donate to the Project</a><ul>
<li><a href="#paypal">Paypal</a></li>
<li><a href="#liberapay">Liberapay</a></li>
<li><a href="#flattr">Flattr</a></li>
<li><a href="#bitcoin">Bitcoin</a></li>
<li><a href="#cheque">Cheque</a></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div id="donation-usage">
<p>Financial help is needed for different reasons. The annual <a href="https://libregraphicsmeeting.org/">Libre Graphics Meeting</a> is one of these things. It helps to get as many <a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Developers</a> to the conference as possible, so that we can do face-to-face team meetings, plan further development, fix bugs, and write new&nbsp;features.</p>
</div>
<p>If applicable, please specify whether you want to remain anonymous. While we usually don&#8217;t publish the names of donors, this may be considered for exceptional&nbsp;donations.</p>
<p>Many thanks to all our <a href="sponsors.html">sponsors</a>!</p>
<h3 id="paypal">Paypal<a class="headerlink" href="#paypal" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p><a href="https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr?cmd=_donations&amp;business=gimp%40gnome%2eorg&amp;lc=US&amp;item_name=Donation%20to%20GIMP%20Project&amp;item_number=106&amp;currency_code=USD">Donate to gimp@gnome.org</a>, this will notify us, and the <span class="caps">GNOME</span> board, that funds have been donated to the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project. Credit card donations are also accepted via this&nbsp;route.</p>
<form action="https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr" method="post"><input name="cmd" type="hidden" value="_xclick"><input name="business" type="hidden" value="gimp@gnome.org"><input name="item_name" type="hidden" value="Donation to GIMP Project"><input name="item_number" type="hidden" value="106"><input name="no_shipping" type="hidden" value="1"><input alt="Support GIMP" name="submit" src="donate.png" type="image"></form>

<h3 id="liberapay">Liberapay<a class="headerlink" href="#liberapay" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p><a href="https://liberapay.com/GIMP/">Donate to <span class="caps">GIMP</span> on Liberapay</a>. Liberapay is a platform run by a non-profit organization allowing monthly crowdfunding (subscription based). See Wikipedia&#8217;s page on <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liberapay">Liberapay</a>.</p>
<h3 id="flattr">Flattr<a class="headerlink" href="#flattr" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p><a href="https://flattr.com/thing/707850">Donate to <span class="caps">GIMP</span> with Flattr</a>. Flattr is a microdonation system. Users are able to pay a small amount every month (minimum 2 euros) and then click Flattr buttons on sites to share the money they paid among those sites, comparable to an Internet tip jar (for more details see Wikipedia&#8217;s <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flattr">Flattr</a>&nbsp;article).</p>
<p><a class="FlattrButton"
title="Click to Flattr GIMP"
data-flattr-uid="schumaml"
data-flattr-popout="1"
data-flattr-description="GNU Image Manipulation Program (GIMP)"
data-flattr-url="https://www.gimp.org/"
href="https://flattr.com/thing/707850">
<img src='/theme/images/flattr-badge-large.png' alt='Flattr GIMP'/>
</a></p>
<h3 id="bitcoin">Bitcoin<a class="headerlink" href="#bitcoin" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p>Bitcoin (<span class="caps">BTC</span>) is an online digital currency that is based on an open-source, peer-to-peer encryption protocol first described in 2009 by a pseudonymous developer (or developers) Satoshi Nakamoto. Bitcoin is not managed by any government or central authority. Instead, it relies on an Internet-based network (for more details see Wikipedia&#8217;s <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitcoin">Bitcoin</a>&nbsp;article).</p>
<p>Bitcoin address: <a href="bitcoin:1NVMCeoBfTAJQ1qwX2Dx1C8zkcRCQWwHBq?label=GIMP%20Donation">1NVMCeoBfTAJQ1qwX2Dx1C8zkcRCQWwHBq</a></p>
<h3 id="cheque">Cheque<a class="headerlink" href="#cheque" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p>Cheque, made payable to the <a href="https://www.gnome.org/"><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation</a>, and sent&nbsp;to:</p>
<p><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation
 #117
 21 Orinda Way Ste. C
 Orinda, <span class="caps">CA</span> 94563
 <span class="caps">USA</span></p>
<p>with a cover-letter (or a note in the &#8220;memo&#8221; field) saying it is for the <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;project.</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

<p>with a cover-letter (or a note in the &#8220;memo&#8221; field) saying it is for the <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;project.</p>

    <div class="container title">
        <div class="row clearfix">
            <div class="column full">
                <h1>Donate</h1>
                
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <section class='page_content'>
        <div class='container'>
            <div class='row clearfix'>
                <div class='column full'>
                    <p>Donating money to the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project is easy and important as it allows the
project&nbsp;sustainability.</p>
<h2 id="fund-core-team-developers-directly">Fund Core Team Developers Directly<a class="headerlink" href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>While we don&#8217;t raise funds to sponsor development as an organization yet, we encourage contributor&nbsp;fundraisers:</p>
<p class='buttons'>
  <a href="https://www.patreon.com/pippin">
    <span class='donate-button'>
      Fund Øyvind Kolås<sup>1</sup><br/>
      <strong><span class="caps">GEGL</span> development</strong>
    </span>
  </a>
  <a href="https://www.patreon.com/zemarmot">
    <span class='donate-button'>
      Fund ZeMarmot<sup>2</sup><br/>
      <strong><span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;development</strong>
    </span>
  </a>
</p>

<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Øyvind Kolås</strong> <a href="https://www.patreon.com/pippin">raises funds</a> for his work on <a href="http://gegl.org/"><span class="caps">GEGL</span></a>, <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&#8217;s new sophisticated image processing core. This work is crucial to implement features such as non-destructive editing in <span class="caps">GIMP</span>, including features known as adjustment layers and layer effects in similar software. Øyvind is the <span class="caps">GEGL</span> maintainer and its primary developer who has been working on it since&nbsp;mid-2000s.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Aryeom and Jehan</strong> <a href="https://www.patreon.com/zemarmot">raise funds</a> for <span class="caps">GIMP</span> development and a <span class="caps">GIMP</span>-powered animated movie: <strong>ZeMarmot</strong> (Libre Art, Creative Commons by-sa 4.0 licenses). The funds allow developing features for professional graphics usage and keeping <span class="caps">GIMP</span> bug-free. Jehan is a <span class="caps">GIMP</span> maintainer and has been one of its most active contributors since 2012, while Aryeom designs and tests features in production ever since, in a professional&nbsp;context.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="donate-to-the-project">Donate to the Project<a class="headerlink" href="#donate-to-the-project" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>The <a href="https://www.gnome.org/"><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation</a> has graciously agreed to act as fiscal agents for us. Contributions to the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project can be made by donating to the <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation and specifying the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project as the recipient. The <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation is a tax-exempt, non-profit 501(c)(3) organization and all donations are tax-deductible in the <span class="caps">USA</span>.</p>
<p>So far <strong>donation through <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation can only be used for community needs</strong> (conferences, developer meetings… see <a href="#donation-usage">below</a>) and material renewal. <a href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly">If you would rather fund paid development, favour Core Team developer funding above</a>.</p>
<p>You can choose from several options to support <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;financially:</p>
<div class="toc">
<ul>
<li><a href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly">Fund Core Team Developers&nbsp;Directly</a></li>
<li><a href="#donate-to-the-project">Donate to the Project</a><ul>
<li><a href="#paypal">Paypal</a></li>
<li><a href="#liberapay">Liberapay</a></li>
<li><a href="#flattr">Flattr</a></li>
<li><a href="#bitcoin">Bitcoin</a></li>
<li><a href="#cheque">Cheque</a></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div id="donation-usage">
<p>Financial help is needed for different reasons. The annual <a href="https://libregraphicsmeeting.org/">Libre Graphics Meeting</a> is one of these things. It helps to get as many <a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Developers</a> to the conference as possible, so that we can do face-to-face team meetings, plan further development, fix bugs, and write new&nbsp;features.</p>
</div>
<p>If applicable, please specify whether you want to remain anonymous. While we usually don&#8217;t publish the names of donors, this may be considered for exceptional&nbsp;donations.</p>
<p>Many thanks to all our <a href="sponsors.html">sponsors</a>!</p>
<h3 id="paypal">Paypal<a class="headerlink" href="#paypal" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p><a href="https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr?cmd=_donations&amp;business=gimp%40gnome%2eorg&amp;lc=US&amp;item_name=Donation%20to%20GIMP%20Project&amp;item_number=106&amp;currency_code=USD">Donate to gimp@gnome.org</a>, this will notify us, and the <span class="caps">GNOME</span> board, that funds have been donated to the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project. Credit card donations are also accepted via this&nbsp;route.</p>
<form action="https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr" method="post"><input name="cmd" type="hidden" value="_xclick"><input name="business" type="hidden" value="gimp@gnome.org"><input name="item_name" type="hidden" value="Donation to GIMP Project"><input name="item_number" type="hidden" value="106"><input name="no_shipping" type="hidden" value="1"><input alt="Support GIMP" name="submit" src="donate.png" type="image"></form>

<h3 id="liberapay">Liberapay<a class="headerlink" href="#liberapay" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p><a href="https://liberapay.com/GIMP/">Donate to <span class="caps">GIMP</span> on Liberapay</a>. Liberapay is a platform run by a non-profit organization allowing monthly crowdfunding (subscription based). See Wikipedia&#8217;s page on <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liberapay">Liberapay</a>.</p>
<h3 id="flattr">Flattr<a class="headerlink" href="#flattr" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p><a href="https://flattr.com/thing/707850">Donate to <span class="caps">GIMP</span> with Flattr</a>. Flattr is a microdonation system. Users are able to pay a small amount every month (minimum 2 euros) and then click Flattr buttons on sites to share the money they paid among those sites, comparable to an Internet tip jar (for more details see Wikipedia&#8217;s <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flattr">Flattr</a>&nbsp;article).</p>
<p><a class="FlattrButton"
title="Click to Flattr GIMP"
data-flattr-uid="schumaml"
data-flattr-popout="1"
data-flattr-description="GNU Image Manipulation Program (GIMP)"
data-flattr-url="https://www.gimp.org/"
href="https://flattr.com/thing/707850">
<img src='/theme/images/flattr-badge-large.png' alt='Flattr GIMP'/>
</a></p>
<h3 id="bitcoin">Bitcoin<a class="headerlink" href="#bitcoin" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p>Bitcoin (<span class="caps">BTC</span>) is an online digital currency that is based on an open-source, peer-to-peer encryption protocol first described in 2009 by a pseudonymous developer (or developers) Satoshi Nakamoto. Bitcoin is not managed by any government or central authority. Instead, it relies on an Internet-based network (for more details see Wikipedia&#8217;s <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitcoin">Bitcoin</a>&nbsp;article).</p>
<p>Bitcoin address: <a href="bitcoin:1NVMCeoBfTAJQ1qwX2Dx1C8zkcRCQWwHBq?label=GIMP%20Donation">1NVMCeoBfTAJQ1qwX2Dx1C8zkcRCQWwHBq</a></p>
<h3 id="cheque">Cheque<a class="headerlink" href="#cheque" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p>Cheque, made payable to the <a href="https://www.gnome.org/"><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation</a>, and sent&nbsp;to:</p>
<p><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation
 #117
 21 Orinda Way Ste. C
 Orinda, <span class="caps">CA</span> 94563
 <span class="caps">USA</span></p>
<p>with a cover-letter (or a note in the &#8220;memo&#8221; field) saying it is for the <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;project.</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

<p><a href="https://flattr.com/thing/707850">Donate to <span class="caps">GIMP</span> with Flattr</a>. Flattr is a microdonation system. Users are able to pay a small amount every month (minimum 2 euros) and then click Flattr buttons on sites to share the money they paid among those sites, comparable to an Internet tip jar (for more details see Wikipedia&#8217;s <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flattr">Flattr</a>&nbsp;article).</p>
<p><a class="FlattrButton"
title="Click to Flattr GIMP"
data-flattr-uid="schumaml"
data-flattr-popout="1"
data-flattr-description="GNU Image Manipulation Program (GIMP)"
data-flattr-url="https://www.gimp.org/"
href="https://flattr.com/thing/707850">
<img src='/theme/images/flattr-badge-large.png' alt='Flattr GIMP'/>
</a></p>
<h3 id="bitcoin">Bitcoin<a class="headerlink" href="#bitcoin" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p>Bitcoin (<span class="caps">BTC</span>) is an online digital currency that is based on an open-source, peer-to-peer encryption protocol first described in 2009 by a pseudonymous developer (or developers) Satoshi Nakamoto. Bitcoin is not managed by any government or central authority. Instead, it relies on an Internet-based network (for more details see Wikipedia&#8217;s <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitcoin">Bitcoin</a>&nbsp;article).</p>
<p>Bitcoin address: <a href="bitcoin:1NVMCeoBfTAJQ1qwX2Dx1C8zkcRCQWwHBq?label=GIMP%20Donation">1NVMCeoBfTAJQ1qwX2Dx1C8zkcRCQWwHBq</a></p>

<h2 id="fund-core-team-developers-directly">Fund Core Team Developers Directly<a class="headerlink" href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>While we don&#8217;t raise funds to sponsor development as an organization yet, we encourage contributor&nbsp;fundraisers:</p>
<p class='buttons'>
  <a href="https://www.patreon.com/pippin">
    <span class='donate-button'>
      Fund Øyvind Kolås<sup>1</sup><br/>
      <strong><span class="caps">GEGL</span> development</strong>
    </span>
  </a>
  <a href="https://www.patreon.com/zemarmot">
    <span class='donate-button'>
      Fund ZeMarmot<sup>2</sup><br/>
      <strong><span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;development</strong>
    </span>
  </a>
</p>

<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Øyvind Kolås</strong> <a href="https://www.patreon.com/pippin">raises funds</a> for his work on <a href="http://gegl.org/"><span class="caps">GEGL</span></a>, <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&#8217;s new sophisticated image processing core. This work is crucial to implement features such as non-destructive editing in <span class="caps">GIMP</span>, including features known as adjustment layers and layer effects in similar software. Øyvind is the <span class="caps">GEGL</span> maintainer and its primary developer who has been working on it since&nbsp;mid-2000s.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Aryeom and Jehan</strong> <a href="https://www.patreon.com/zemarmot">raise funds</a> for <span class="caps">GIMP</span> development and a <span class="caps">GIMP</span>-powered animated movie: <strong>ZeMarmot</strong> (Libre Art, Creative Commons by-sa 4.0 licenses). The funds allow developing features for professional graphics usage and keeping <span class="caps">GIMP</span> bug-free. Jehan is a <span class="caps">GIMP</span> maintainer and has been one of its most active contributors since 2012, while Aryeom designs and tests features in production ever since, in a professional&nbsp;context.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="donate-to-the-project">Donate to the Project<a class="headerlink" href="#donate-to-the-project" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>The <a href="https://www.gnome.org/"><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation</a> has graciously agreed to act as fiscal agents for us. Contributions to the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project can be made by donating to the <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation and specifying the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project as the recipient. The <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation is a tax-exempt, non-profit 501(c)(3) organization and all donations are tax-deductible in the <span class="caps">USA</span>.</p>
<p>So far <strong>donation through <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation can only be used for community needs</strong> (conferences, developer meetings… see <a href="#donation-usage">below</a>) and material renewal. <a href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly">If you would rather fund paid development, favour Core Team developer funding above</a>.</p>
<p>You can choose from several options to support <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;financially:</p>
<div class="toc">
<ul>
<li><a href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly">Fund Core Team Developers&nbsp;Directly</a></li>
<li><a href="#donate-to-the-project">Donate to the Project</a><ul>
<li><a href="#paypal">Paypal</a></li>
<li><a href="#liberapay">Liberapay</a></li>
<li><a href="#flattr">Flattr</a></li>
<li><a href="#bitcoin">Bitcoin</a></li>
<li><a href="#cheque">Cheque</a></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div id="donation-usage">
<p>Financial help is needed for different reasons. The annual <a href="https://libregraphicsmeeting.org/">Libre Graphics Meeting</a> is one of these things. It helps to get as many <a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Developers</a> to the conference as possible, so that we can do face-to-face team meetings, plan further development, fix bugs, and write new&nbsp;features.</p>
</div>
<p>If applicable, please specify whether you want to remain anonymous. While we usually don&#8217;t publish the names of donors, this may be considered for exceptional&nbsp;donations.</p>
<p>Many thanks to all our <a href="sponsors.html">sponsors</a>!</p>
<h3 id="paypal">Paypal<a class="headerlink" href="#paypal" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p><a href="https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr?cmd=_donations&amp;business=gimp%40gnome%2eorg&amp;lc=US&amp;item_name=Donation%20to%20GIMP%20Project&amp;item_number=106&amp;currency_code=USD">Donate to gimp@gnome.org</a>, this will notify us, and the <span class="caps">GNOME</span> board, that funds have been donated to the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project. Credit card donations are also accepted via this&nbsp;route.</p>

<h3 id="liberapay">Liberapay<a class="headerlink" href="#liberapay" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>

Liberapay is a platform run by a non-profit organization allowing monthly crowdfunding (subscription based). See Wikipedia&#8217;s page on <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liberapay">Liberapay</a>.</p>
<h3 id="flattr">Flattr<a class="headerlink" href="#flattr" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p><a href="https://flattr.com/thing/707850">Donate to <span class="caps">GIMP</span> with Flattr</a>. Flattr is a microdonation system. Users are able to pay a small amount every month (minimum 2 euros) and then click Flattr buttons on sites to share the money they paid among those sites, comparable to an Internet tip jar (for more details see Wikipedia&#8217;s <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flattr">Flattr</a>&nbsp;article).</p>
<p><a class="FlattrButton"
title="Click to Flattr GIMP"
data-flattr-uid="schumaml"
data-flattr-popout="1"
data-flattr-description="GNU Image Manipulation Program (GIMP)"
data-flattr-url="https://www.gimp.org/"
href="https://flattr.com/thing/707850">
<img src='/theme/images/flattr-badge-large.png' alt='Flattr GIMP'/>
</a></p>
<h3 id="bitcoin">Bitcoin<a class="headerlink" href="#bitcoin" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p>Bitcoin (<span class="caps">BTC</span>) is an online digital currency that is based on an open-source, peer-to-peer encryption protocol first described in 2009 by a pseudonymous developer (or developers) Satoshi Nakamoto. Bitcoin is not managed by any government or central authority. Instead, it relies on an Internet-based network (for more details see Wikipedia&#8217;s <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitcoin">Bitcoin</a>&nbsp;article).</p>
<p>Bitcoin address: <a href="bitcoin:1NVMCeoBfTAJQ1qwX2Dx1C8zkcRCQWwHBq?label=GIMP%20Donation">1NVMCeoBfTAJQ1qwX2Dx1C8zkcRCQWwHBq</a></p>
<h3 id="cheque">Cheque<a class="headerlink" href="#cheque" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p>Cheque, made payable to the <a href="https://www.gnome.org/"><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation</a>, and sent&nbsp;to:</p>
<p><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation
 #117
 21 Orinda Way Ste. C
 Orinda, <span class="caps">CA</span> 94563
 <span class="caps">USA</span></p>
<p>with a cover-letter (or a note in the &#8220;memo&#8221; field) saying it is for the <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;project.</p>

</html>https://www.gimp.org/donatingpan class='donate-button'>
      Fund ZeMarmot<sup>2</sup><br/>
      <strong><span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;development</strong>
    </span>
  </a>
</p>

<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Øyvind Kolås</strong> <a href="https://www.patreon.com/pippin">raises funds</a> for his work on <a href="http://gegl.org/"><span class="caps">GEGL</span></a>, <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&#8217;s new sophisticated image processing core. This work is crucial to implement features such as non-destructive editing in <span class="caps">GIMP</span>, including features known as adjustment layers and layer effects in similar software. Øyvind is the <span class="caps">GEGL</span> maintainer and its primary developer who has been working on it since&nbsp;mid-2000s.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Aryeom and Jehan</strong> <a href="https://www.patreon.com/zemarmot">raise funds</a> for <span class="caps">GIMP</span> development and a <span class="caps">GIMP</span>-powered animated movie: <strong>ZeMarmot</strong> (Libre Art, Creative Commons by-sa 4.0 licenses). The funds allow developing features for professional graphics usage and keeping <span class="caps">GIMP</span> bug-free. Jehan is a <span class="caps">GIMP</span> maintainer and has been one of its most active contributors since 2012, while Aryeom designs and tests features in production ever since, in a professional&nbsp;context.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="donate-to-the-project">Donate to the Project<a class="headerlink" href="#donate-to-the-project" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>The <a href="https://www.gnome.org/"><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation</a> has graciously agreed to act as fiscal agents for us. Contributions to the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project can be made by donating to the <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation and specifying the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project as the recipient. The <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation is a tax-exempt, non-profit 501(c)(3) organization and all donations are tax-deductible in the <span class="caps">USA</span>.</p>
<p>So far <strong>donation through <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation can only be used for community needs</strong> (conferences, developer meetings… see <a href="#donation-usage">below</a>) and material renewal. <a href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly">If you would rather fund paid development, favour Core Team developer funding above</a>.</p>
<p>You can choose from several options to support <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;financially:</p>
<div class="toc">
<ul>
<li><a href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly">Fund Core Team Developers&nbsp;Directly</a></li>
<li><a href="#donate-to-the-project">Donate to the Project</a><ul>
<li><a href="#paypal">Paypal</a></li>
<li><a href="#liberapay">Liberapay</a></li>
<li><a href="#flattr">Flattr</a></li>
<li><a href="#bitcoin">Bitcoin</a></li>
<li><a href="#cheque">Cheque</a></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div id="donation-usage">
<p>Financial help is needed for different reasons. The annual <a href="https://libregraphicsmeeting.org/">Libre Graphics Meeting</a> is one of these things. It helps to get as many <a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Developers</a> to the conference as possible, so that we can do face-to-face team meetings, plan further development, fix bugs, and write new&nbsp;features.</p>
</div>
<p>If applicable, please specify whether you want to remain anonymous. While we usually don&#8217;t publish the names of donors, this may be considered for exceptional&nbsp;donations.</p>
<p>Many thanks to all our <a href="sponsors.html">sponsors</a>!</p>
<h3 id="paypal">Paypal<a class="headerlink" href="#paypal" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>

Credit card donations are also accepted via this&nbsp;route.</p>

Users are able to pay a small amount every month (minimum 2 euros) and then click Flattr buttons on sites to share the money they paid among those sites, comparable to an Internet tip jar (for more details see Wikipedia&#8217;s <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flattr">Flattr</a>&nbsp;article).</p>
<p><a class="FlattrButton"
title="Click to Flattr GIMP"
data-flattr-uid="schumaml"
data-flattr-popout="1"
data-flattr-description="GNU Image Manipulation Program (GIMP)"
data-flattr-url="https://www.gimp.org/"
href="https://flattr.com/thing/707850">
<img src='/theme/images/flattr-badge-large.png' alt='Flattr GIMP'/>
</a></p>
<h3 id="bitcoin">Bitcoin<a class="headerlink" href="#bitcoin" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p>Bitcoin (<span class="caps">BTC</span>) is an online digital currency that is based on an open-source, peer-to-peer encryption protocol first described in 2009 by a pseudonymous developer (or developers) Satoshi Nakamoto. Bitcoin is not managed by any government or central authority. Instead, it relies on an Internet-based network (for more details see Wikipedia&#8217;s <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitcoin">Bitcoin</a>&nbsp;article).</p>
<p>Bitcoin address: <a href="bitcoin:1NVMCeoBfTAJQ1qwX2Dx1C8zkcRCQWwHBq?label=GIMP%20Donation">1NVMCeoBfTAJQ1qwX2Dx1C8zkcRCQWwHBq</a></p>
<h3 id="cheque">Cheque<a class="headerlink" href="#cheque" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p>Cheque, made payable to the <a href="https://www.gnome.org/"><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation</a>, and sent&nbsp;to:</p>
<p><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation
 #117
 21 Orinda Way Ste. C
 Orinda, <span class="caps">CA</span> 94563
 <span class="caps">USA</span></p>
<p>with a cover-letter (or a note in the &#8220;memo&#8221; field) saying it is for the <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;project.</p>

<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Øyvind Kolås</strong> <a href="https://www.patreon.com/pippin">raises funds</a> for his work on <a href="http://gegl.org/"><span class="caps">GEGL</span></a>, <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&#8217;s new sophisticated image processing core. This work is crucial to implement features such as non-destructive editing in <span class="caps">GIMP</span>, including features known as adjustment layers and layer effects in similar software. Øyvind is the <span class="caps">GEGL</span> maintainer and its primary developer who has been working on it since&nbsp;mid-2000s.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Aryeom and Jehan</strong> <a href="https://www.patreon.com/zemarmot">raise funds</a> for <span class="caps">GIMP</span> development and a <span class="caps">GIMP</span>-powered animated movie: <strong>ZeMarmot</strong> (Libre Art, Creative Commons by-sa 4.0 licenses). The funds allow developing features for professional graphics usage and keeping <span class="caps">GIMP</span> bug-free. Jehan is a <span class="caps">GIMP</span> maintainer and has been one of its most active contributors since 2012, while Aryeom designs and tests features in production ever since, in a professional&nbsp;context.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="donate-to-the-project">Donate to the Project<a class="headerlink" href="#donate-to-the-project" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>The <a href="https://www.gnome.org/"><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation</a> has graciously agreed to act as fiscal agents for us. Contributions to the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project can be made by donating to the <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation and specifying the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project as the recipient. The <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation is a tax-exempt, non-profit 501(c)(3) organization and all donations are tax-deductible in the <span class="caps">USA</span>.</p>
<p>So far <strong>donation through <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation can only be used for community needs</strong> (conferences, developer meetings… see <a href="#donation-usage">below</a>) and material renewal. <a href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly">If you would rather fund paid development, favour Core Team developer funding above</a>.</p>
<p>You can choose from several options to support <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;financially:</p>
<div class="toc">
<ul>
<li><a href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly">Fund Core Team Developers&nbsp;Directly</a></li>
<li><a href="#donate-to-the-project">Donate to the Project</a><ul>
<li><a href="#paypal">Paypal</a></li>
<li><a href="#liberapay">Liberapay</a></li>
<li><a href="#flattr">Flattr</a></li>
<li><a href="#bitcoin">Bitcoin</a></li>
<li><a href="#cheque">Cheque</a></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div id="donation-usage">
<p>Financial help is needed for different reasons. The annual <a href="https://libregraphicsmeeting.org/">Libre Graphics Meeting</a> is one of these things. It helps to get as many <a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Developers</a> to the conference as possible, so that we can do face-to-face team meetings, plan further development, fix bugs, and write new&nbsp;features.</p>
</div>
<p>If applicable, please specify whether you want to remain anonymous. While we usually don&#8217;t publish the names of donors, this may be considered for exceptional&nbsp;donations.</p>
<p>Many thanks to all our <a href="sponsors.html">sponsors</a>!</p>
<h3 id="paypal">Paypal<a class="headerlink" href="#paypal" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p><a href="https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr?cmd=_donations&amp;business=gimp%40gnome%2eorg&amp;lc=US&amp;item_name=Donation%20to%20GIMP%20Project&amp;item_number=106&amp;currency_code=USD">Donate to gimp@gnome.org</a>, this will notify us, and the <span class="caps">GNOME</span> board, that funds have been donated to the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project. Credit card donations are also accepted via this&nbsp;route.</p>

Instead, it relies on an Internet-based network (for more details see Wikipedia&#8217;s <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitcoin">Bitcoin</a>&nbsp;article).</p>
<p>Bitcoin address: <a href="bitcoin:1NVMCeoBfTAJQ1qwX2Dx1C8zkcRCQWwHBq?label=GIMP%20Donation">1NVMCeoBfTAJQ1qwX2Dx1C8zkcRCQWwHBq</a></p>

<h2 id="donate-to-the-project">Donate to the Project<a class="headerlink" href="#donate-to-the-project" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>The <a href="https://www.gnome.org/"><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation</a> has graciously agreed to act as fiscal agents for us. Contributions to the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project can be made by donating to the <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation and specifying the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project as the recipient. The <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation is a tax-exempt, non-profit 501(c)(3) organization and all donations are tax-deductible in the <span class="caps">USA</span>.</p>
<p>So far <strong>donation through <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation can only be used for community needs</strong> (conferences, developer meetings… see <a href="#donation-usage">below</a>) and material renewal. <a href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly">If you would rather fund paid development, favour Core Team developer funding above</a>.</p>
<p>You can choose from several options to support <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;financially:</p>
<div class="toc">
<ul>
<li><a href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly">Fund Core Team Developers&nbsp;Directly</a></li>
<li><a href="#donate-to-the-project">Donate to the Project</a><ul>
<li><a href="#paypal">Paypal</a></li>
<li><a href="#liberapay">Liberapay</a></li>
<li><a href="#flattr">Flattr</a></li>
<li><a href="#bitcoin">Bitcoin</a></li>
<li><a href="#cheque">Cheque</a></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div id="donation-usage">
<p>Financial help is needed for different reasons. The annual <a href="https://libregraphicsmeeting.org/">Libre Graphics Meeting</a> is one of these things. It helps to get as many <a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Developers</a> to the conference as possible, so that we can do face-to-face team meetings, plan further development, fix bugs, and write new&nbsp;features.</p>
</div>
<p>If applicable, please specify whether you want to remain anonymous. While we usually don&#8217;t publish the names of donors, this may be considered for exceptional&nbsp;donations.</p>
<p>Many thanks to all our <a href="sponsors.html">sponsors</a>!</p>

Credit card donations are also accepted via this&nbsp;route.</p>

<h2 id="donate-to-the-project">Donate to the Project<a class="headerlink" href="#donate-to-the-project" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>The <a href="https://www.gnome.org/"><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation</a> has graciously agreed to act as fiscal agents for us. Contributions to the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project can be made by donating to the <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation and specifying the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project as the recipient. The <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation is a tax-exempt, non-profit 501(c)(3) organization and all donations are tax-deductible in the <span class="caps">USA</span>.</p>
<p>So far <strong>donation through <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation can only be used for community needs</strong> (conferences, developer meetings… see <a href="#donation-usage">below</a>) and material renewal. <a href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly">If you would rather fund paid development, favour Core Team developer funding above</a>.</p>
<p>You can choose from several options to support <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;financially:</p>
<div class="toc">
<ul>
<li><a href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly">Fund Core Team Developers&nbsp;Directly</a></li>
<li><a href="#donate-to-the-project">Donate to the Project</a><ul>
<li><a href="#paypal">Paypal</a></li>
<li><a href="#liberapay">Liberapay</a></li>
<li><a href="#flattr">Flattr</a></li>
<li><a href="#bitcoin">Bitcoin</a></li>
<li><a href="#cheque">Cheque</a></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div id="donation-usage">
<p>Financial help is needed for different reasons. The annual <a href="https://libregraphicsmeeting.org/">Libre Graphics Meeting</a> is one of these things. It helps to get as many <a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Developers</a> to the conference as possible, so that we can do face-to-face team meetings, plan further development, fix bugs, and write new&nbsp;features.</p>
</div>
<p>If applicable, please specify whether you want to remain anonymous. While we usually don&#8217;t publish the names of donors, this may be considered for exceptional&nbsp;donations.</p>
<p>Many thanks to all our <a href="sponsors.html">sponsors</a>!</p>
<h3 id="paypal">Paypal<a class="headerlink" href="#paypal" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p><a href="https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr?cmd=_donations&amp;business=gimp%40gnome%2eorg&amp;lc=US&amp;item_name=Donation%20to%20GIMP%20Project&amp;item_number=106&amp;currency_code=USD">Donate to gimp@gnome.org</a>, this will notify us, and the <span class="caps">GNOME</span> board, that funds have been donated to the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project. Credit card donations are also accepted via this&nbsp;route.</p>
<form action="https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr" method="post"><input name="cmd" type="hidden" value="_xclick"><input name="business" type="hidden" value="gimp@gnome.org"><input name="item_name" type="hidden" value="Donation to GIMP Project"><input name="item_number" type="hidden" value="106"><input name="no_shipping" type="hidden" value="1"><input alt="Support GIMP" name="submit" src="donate.png" type="image"></form>

<h3 id="liberapay">Liberapay<a class="headerlink" href="#liberapay" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p><a href="https://liberapay.com/GIMP/">Donate to <span class="caps">GIMP</span> on Liberapay</a>. Liberapay is a platform run by a non-profit organization allowing monthly crowdfunding (subscription based). See Wikipedia&#8217;s page on <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liberapay">Liberapay</a>.</p>
<h3 id="flattr">Flattr<a class="headerlink" href="#flattr" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p><a href="https://flattr.com/thing/707850">Donate to <span class="caps">GIMP</span> with Flattr</a>. Flattr is a microdonation system. Users are able to pay a small amount every month (minimum 2 euros) and then click Flattr buttons on sites to share the money they paid among those sites, comparable to an Internet tip jar (for more details see Wikipedia&#8217;s <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flattr">Flattr</a>&nbsp;article).</p>
<p><a class="FlattrButton"
title="Click to Flattr GIMP"
data-flattr-uid="schumaml"
data-flattr-popout="1"
data-flattr-description="GNU Image Manipulation Program (GIMP)"
data-flattr-url="https://www.gimp.org/"
href="https://flattr.com/thing/707850">
<img src='/theme/images/flattr-badge-large.png' alt='Flattr GIMP'/>
</a></p>
<h3 id="bitcoin">Bitcoin<a class="headerlink" href="#bitcoin" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p>Bitcoin (<span class="caps">BTC</span>) is an online digital currency that is based on an open-source, peer-to-peer encryption protocol first described in 2009 by a pseudonymous developer (or developers) Satoshi Nakamoto. Bitcoin is not managed by any government or central authority. Instead, it relies on an Internet-based network (for more details see Wikipedia&#8217;s <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitcoin">Bitcoin</a>&nbsp;article).</p>
<p>Bitcoin address: <a href="bitcoin:1NVMCeoBfTAJQ1qwX2Dx1C8zkcRCQWwHBq?label=GIMP%20Donation">1NVMCeoBfTAJQ1qwX2Dx1C8zkcRCQWwHBq</a></p>
<h3 id="cheque">Cheque<a class="headerlink" href="#cheque" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p>Cheque, made payable to the <a href="https://www.gnome.org/"><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation</a>, and sent&nbsp;to:</p>
<p><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation
 #117
 21 Orinda Way Ste. C
 Orinda, <span class="caps">CA</span> 94563
 <span class="caps">USA</span></p>
<p>with a cover-letter (or a note in the &#8220;memo&#8221; field) saying it is for the <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;project.</p>

<h2 id="donate-to-the-project">Donate to the Project<a class="headerlink" href="#donate-to-the-project" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>The <a href="https://www.gnome.org/"><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation</a> has graciously agreed to act as fiscal agents for us. Contributions to the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project can be made by donating to the <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation and specifying the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project as the recipient. The <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation is a tax-exempt, non-profit 501(c)(3) organization and all donations are tax-deductible in the <span class="caps">USA</span>.</p>
<p>So far <strong>donation through <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation can only be used for community needs</strong> (conferences, developer meetings… see <a href="#donation-usage">below</a>) and material renewal. <a href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly">If you would rather fund paid development, favour Core Team developer funding above</a>.</p>
<p>You can choose from several options to support <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;financially:</p>
<div class="toc">
<ul>
<li><a href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly">Fund Core Team Developers&nbsp;Directly</a></li>
<li><a href="#donate-to-the-project">Donate to the Project</a><ul>
<li><a href="#paypal">Paypal</a></li>
<li><a href="#liberapay">Liberapay</a></li>
<li><a href="#flattr">Flattr</a></li>
<li><a href="#bitcoin">Bitcoin</a></li>
<li><a href="#cheque">Cheque</a></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div id="donation-usage">
<p>Financial help is needed for different reasons. The annual <a href="https://libregraphicsmeeting.org/">Libre Graphics Meeting</a> is one of these things. It helps to get as many <a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Developers</a> to the conference as possible, so that we can do face-to-face team meetings, plan further development, fix bugs, and write new&nbsp;features.</p>
</div>
<p>If applicable, please specify whether you want to remain anonymous. While we usually don&#8217;t publish the names of donors, this may be considered for exceptional&nbsp;donations.</p>
<p>Many thanks to all our <a href="sponsors.html">sponsors</a>!</p>
<h3 id="paypal">Paypal<a class="headerlink" href="#paypal" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p><a href="https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr?cmd=_donations&amp;business=gimp%40gnome%2eorg&amp;lc=US&amp;item_name=Donation%20to%20GIMP%20Project&amp;item_number=106&amp;currency_code=USD">Donate to gimp@gnome.org</a>, this will notify us, and the <span class="caps">GNOME</span> board, that funds have been donated to the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project. Credit card donations are also accepted via this&nbsp;route.</p>
<form action="https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr" method="post"><input name="cmd" type="hidden" value="_xclick"><input name="business" type="hidden" value="gimp@gnome.org"><input name="item_name" type="hidden" value="Donation to GIMP Project"><input name="item_number" type="hidden" value="106"><input name="no_shipping" type="hidden" value="1"><input alt="Support GIMP" name="submit" src="donate.png" type="image"></form>

<h3 id="liberapay">Liberapay<a class="headerlink" href="#liberapay" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p><a href="https://liberapay.com/GIMP/">Donate to <span class="caps">GIMP</span> on Liberapay</a>. Liberapay is a platform run by a non-profit organization allowing monthly crowdfunding (subscription based). See Wikipedia&#8217;s page on <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liberapay">Liberapay</a>.</p>
<h3 id="flattr">Flattr<a class="headerlink" href="#flattr" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p><a href="https://flattr.com/thing/707850">Donate to <span class="caps">GIMP</span> with Flattr</a>. Flattr is a microdonation system. Users are able to pay a small amount every month (minimum 2 euros) and then click Flattr buttons on sites to share the money they paid among those sites, comparable to an Internet tip jar (for more details see Wikipedia&#8217;s <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flattr">Flattr</a>&nbsp;article).</p>
<p><a class="FlattrButton"
title="Click to Flattr GIMP"
data-flattr-uid="schumaml"
data-flattr-popout="1"
data-flattr-description="GNU Image Manipulation Program (GIMP)"
data-flattr-url="https://www.gimp.org/"
href="https://flattr.com/thing/707850">
<img src='/theme/images/flattr-badge-large.png' alt='Flattr GIMP'/>
</a></p>
<h3 id="bitcoin">Bitcoin<a class="headerlink" href="#bitcoin" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p>Bitcoin (<span class="caps">BTC</span>) is an online digital currency that is based on an open-source, peer-to-peer encryption protocol first described in 2009 by a pseudonymous developer (or developers) Satoshi Nakamoto. Bitcoin is not managed by any government or central authority. Instead, it relies on an Internet-based network (for more details see Wikipedia&#8217;s <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitcoin">Bitcoin</a>&nbsp;article).</p>
<p>Bitcoin address: <a href="bitcoin:1NVMCeoBfTAJQ1qwX2Dx1C8zkcRCQWwHBq?label=GIMP%20Donation">1NVMCeoBfTAJQ1qwX2Dx1C8zkcRCQWwHBq</a></p>
<h3 id="cheque">Cheque<a class="headerlink" href="#cheque" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p>Cheque, made payable to the <a href="https://www.gnome.org/"><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation</a>, and sent&nbsp;to:</p>
<p><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation
 #117
 21 Orinda Way Ste. C
 Orinda, <span class="caps">CA</span> 94563
 <span class="caps">USA</span></p>
<p>with a cover-letter (or a note in the &#8220;memo&#8221; field) saying it is for the <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;project.</p>

<h3 id="bitcoin">Bitcoin<a class="headerlink" href="#bitcoin" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p>Bitcoin (<span class="caps">BTC</span>) is an online digital currency that is based on an open-source, peer-to-peer encryption protocol first described in 2009 by a pseudonymous developer (or developers) Satoshi Nakamoto. Bitcoin is not managed by any government or central authority. Instead, it relies on an Internet-based network (for more details see Wikipedia&#8217;s <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitcoin">Bitcoin</a>&nbsp;article).</p>

<h3 id="liberapay">Liberapay<a class="headerlink" href="#liberapay" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p><a href="https://liberapay.com/GIMP/">Donate to <span class="caps">GIMP</span> on Liberapay</a>. Liberapay is a platform run by a non-profit organization allowing monthly crowdfunding (subscription based). See Wikipedia&#8217;s page on <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liberapay">Liberapay</a>.</p>
<h3 id="flattr">Flattr<a class="headerlink" href="#flattr" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p><a href="https://flattr.com/thing/707850">Donate to <span class="caps">GIMP</span> with Flattr</a>. Flattr is a microdonation system. Users are able to pay a small amount every month (minimum 2 euros) and then click Flattr buttons on sites to share the money they paid among those sites, comparable to an Internet tip jar (for more details see Wikipedia&#8217;s <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flattr">Flattr</a>&nbsp;article).</p>
<p><a class="FlattrButton"
title="Click to Flattr GIMP"

</a></p>
<h3 id="bitcoin">Bitcoin<a class="headerlink" href="#bitcoin" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p>Bitcoin (<span class="caps">BTC</span>) is an online digital currency that is based on an open-source, peer-to-peer encryption protocol first described in 2009 by a pseudonymous developer (or developers) Satoshi Nakamoto. Bitcoin is not managed by any government or central authority. Instead, it relies on an Internet-based network (for more details see Wikipedia&#8217;s <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitcoin">Bitcoin</a>&nbsp;article).</p>
<p>Bitcoin address: <a href="bitcoin:1NVMCeoBfTAJQ1qwX2Dx1C8zkcRCQWwHBq?label=GIMP%20Donation">1NVMCeoBfTAJQ1qwX2Dx1C8zkcRCQWwHBq</a></p>

                <h1>Donate</h1>
                
            </div>

    <section class='page_content'>
        <div class='container'>
            <div class='row clearfix'>
                <div class='column full'>
                    <p>Donating money to the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project is easy and important as it allows the
project&nbsp;sustainability.</p>
<h2 id="fund-core-team-developers-directly">Fund Core Team Developers Directly<a class="headerlink" href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>While we don&#8217;t raise funds to sponsor development as an organization yet, we encourage contributor&nbsp;fundraisers:</p>
<p class='buttons'>
  <a href="https://www.patreon.com/pippin">
    <span class='donate-button'>
      Fund Øyvind Kolås<sup>1</sup><br/>
      <strong><span class="caps">GEGL</span> development</strong>
    </span>
  </a>
  <a href="https://www.patreon.com/zemarmot">
    <span class='donate-button'>
      Fund ZeMarmot<sup>2</sup><br/>
      <strong><span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;development</strong>
    </span>
  </a>
</p>

<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Øyvind Kolås</strong> <a href="https://www.patreon.com/pippin">raises funds</a> for his work on <a href="http://gegl.org/"><span class="caps">GEGL</span></a>, <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&#8217;s new sophisticated image processing core. This work is crucial to implement features such as non-destructive editing in <span class="caps">GIMP</span>, including features known as adjustment layers and layer effects in similar software. Øyvind is the <span class="caps">GEGL</span> maintainer and its primary developer who has been working on it since&nbsp;mid-2000s.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Aryeom and Jehan</strong> <a href="https://www.patreon.com/zemarmot">raise funds</a> for <span class="caps">GIMP</span> development and a <span class="caps">GIMP</span>-powered animated movie: <strong>ZeMarmot</strong> (Libre Art, Creative Commons by-sa 4.0 licenses). The funds allow developing features for professional graphics usage and keeping <span class="caps">GIMP</span> bug-free. Jehan is a <span class="caps">GIMP</span> maintainer and has been one of its most active contributors since 2012, while Aryeom designs and tests features in production ever since, in a professional&nbsp;context.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="donate-to-the-project">Donate to the Project<a class="headerlink" href="#donate-to-the-project" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>The <a href="https://www.gnome.org/"><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation</a> has graciously agreed to act as fiscal agents for us. Contributions to the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project can be made by donating to the <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation and specifying the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project as the recipient. The <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation is a tax-exempt, non-profit 501(c)(3) organization and all donations are tax-deductible in the <span class="caps">USA</span>.</p>
<p>So far <strong>donation through <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation can only be used for community needs</strong> (conferences, developer meetings… see <a href="#donation-usage">below</a>) and material renewal. <a href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly">If you would rather fund paid development, favour Core Team developer funding above</a>.</p>
<p>You can choose from several options to support <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;financially:</p>
<div class="toc">
<ul>
<li><a href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly">Fund Core Team Developers&nbsp;Directly</a></li>
<li><a href="#donate-to-the-project">Donate to the Project</a><ul>
<li><a href="#paypal">Paypal</a></li>
<li><a href="#liberapay">Liberapay</a></li>
<li><a href="#flattr">Flattr</a></li>
<li><a href="#bitcoin">Bitcoin</a></li>
<li><a href="#cheque">Cheque</a></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div id="donation-usage">
<p>Financial help is needed for different reasons. The annual <a href="https://libregraphicsmeeting.org/">Libre Graphics Meeting</a> is one of these things. It helps to get as many <a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Developers</a> to the conference as possible, so that we can do face-to-face team meetings, plan further development, fix bugs, and write new&nbsp;features.</p>
</div>
<p>If applicable, please specify whether you want to remain anonymous. While we usually don&#8217;t publish the names of donors, this may be considered for exceptional&nbsp;donations.</p>
<p>Many thanks to all our <a href="sponsors.html">sponsors</a>!</p>
<h3 id="paypal">Paypal<a class="headerlink" href="#paypal" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p><a href="https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr?cmd=_donations&amp;business=gimp%40gnome%2eorg&amp;lc=US&amp;item_name=Donation%20to%20GIMP%20Project&amp;item_number=106&amp;currency_code=USD">Donate to gimp@gnome.org</a>, this will notify us, and the <span class="caps">GNOME</span> board, that funds have been donated to the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project. Credit card donations are also accepted via this&nbsp;route.</p>
<form action="https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr" method="post"><input name="cmd" type="hidden" value="_xclick"><input name="business" type="hidden" value="gimp@gnome.org"><input name="item_name" type="hidden" value="Donation to GIMP Project"><input name="item_number" type="hidden" value="106"><input name="no_shipping" type="hidden" value="1"><input alt="Support GIMP" name="submit" src="donate.png" type="image"></form>

<h3 id="liberapay">Liberapay<a class="headerlink" href="#liberapay" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p><a href="https://liberapay.com/GIMP/">Donate to <span class="caps">GIMP</span> on Liberapay</a>. Liberapay is a platform run by a non-profit organization allowing monthly crowdfunding (subscription based). See Wikipedia&#8217;s page on <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liberapay">Liberapay</a>.</p>
<h3 id="flattr">Flattr<a class="headerlink" href="#flattr" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p><a href="https://flattr.com/thing/707850">Donate to <span class="caps">GIMP</span> with Flattr</a>. Flattr is a microdonation system. Users are able to pay a small amount every month (minimum 2 euros) and then click Flattr buttons on sites to share the money they paid among those sites, comparable to an Internet tip jar (for more details see Wikipedia&#8217;s <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flattr">Flattr</a>&nbsp;article).</p>
<p><a class="FlattrButton"
title="Click to Flattr GIMP"
data-flattr-uid="schumaml"
data-flattr-popout="1"
data-flattr-description="GNU Image Manipulation Program (GIMP)"
data-flattr-url="https://www.gimp.org/"
href="https://flattr.com/thing/707850">
<img src='/theme/images/flattr-badge-large.png' alt='Flattr GIMP'/>
</a></p>
<h3 id="bitcoin">Bitcoin<a class="headerlink" href="#bitcoin" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p>Bitcoin (<span class="caps">BTC</span>) is an online digital currency that is based on an open-source, peer-to-peer encryption protocol first described in 2009 by a pseudonymous developer (or developers) Satoshi Nakamoto. Bitcoin is not managed by any government or central authority. Instead, it relies on an Internet-based network (for more details see Wikipedia&#8217;s <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitcoin">Bitcoin</a>&nbsp;article).</p>
<p>Bitcoin address: <a href="bitcoin:1NVMCeoBfTAJQ1qwX2Dx1C8zkcRCQWwHBq?label=GIMP%20Donation">1NVMCeoBfTAJQ1qwX2Dx1C8zkcRCQWwHBq</a></p>
<h3 id="cheque">Cheque<a class="headerlink" href="#cheque" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p>Cheque, made payable to the <a href="https://www.gnome.org/"><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation</a>, and sent&nbsp;to:</p>
<p><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation
 #117
 21 Orinda Way Ste. C
 Orinda, <span class="caps">CA</span> 94563
 <span class="caps">USA</span></p>
<p>with a cover-letter (or a note in the &#8220;memo&#8221; field) saying it is for the <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;project.</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

            <div class="column full">
                <h1>Donate</h1>
                
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <section class='page_content'>
        <div class='container'>
            <div class='row clearfix'>
                <div class='column full'>
                    <p>Donating money to the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project is easy and important as it allows the
project&nbsp;sustainability.</p>
<h2 id="fund-core-team-developers-directly">Fund Core Team Developers Directly<a class="headerlink" href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>While we don&#8217;t raise funds to sponsor development as an organization yet, we encourage contributor&nbsp;fundraisers:</p>
<p class='buttons'>
  <a href="https://www.patreon.com/pippin">
    <span class='donate-button'>
      Fund Øyvind Kolås<sup>1</sup><br/>
      <strong><span class="caps">GEGL</span> development</strong>
    </span>
  </a>
  <a href="https://www.patreon.com/zemarmot">
    <span class='donate-button'>
      Fund ZeMarmot<sup>2</sup><br/>
      <strong><span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;development</strong>
    </span>
  </a>
</p>

<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Øyvind Kolås</strong> <a href="https://www.patreon.com/pippin">raises funds</a> for his work on <a href="http://gegl.org/"><span class="caps">GEGL</span></a>, <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&#8217;s new sophisticated image processing core. This work is crucial to implement features such as non-destructive editing in <span class="caps">GIMP</span>, including features known as adjustment layers and layer effects in similar software. Øyvind is the <span class="caps">GEGL</span> maintainer and its primary developer who has been working on it since&nbsp;mid-2000s.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Aryeom and Jehan</strong> <a href="https://www.patreon.com/zemarmot">raise funds</a> for <span class="caps">GIMP</span> development and a <span class="caps">GIMP</span>-powered animated movie: <strong>ZeMarmot</strong> (Libre Art, Creative Commons by-sa 4.0 licenses). The funds allow developing features for professional graphics usage and keeping <span class="caps">GIMP</span> bug-free. Jehan is a <span class="caps">GIMP</span> maintainer and has been one of its most active contributors since 2012, while Aryeom designs and tests features in production ever since, in a professional&nbsp;context.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="donate-to-the-project">Donate to the Project<a class="headerlink" href="#donate-to-the-project" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>The <a href="https://www.gnome.org/"><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation</a> has graciously agreed to act as fiscal agents for us. Contributions to the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project can be made by donating to the <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation and specifying the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project as the recipient. The <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation is a tax-exempt, non-profit 501(c)(3) organization and all donations are tax-deductible in the <span class="caps">USA</span>.</p>
<p>So far <strong>donation through <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation can only be used for community needs</strong> (conferences, developer meetings… see <a href="#donation-usage">below</a>) and material renewal. <a href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly">If you would rather fund paid development, favour Core Team developer funding above</a>.</p>
<p>You can choose from several options to support <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;financially:</p>
<div class="toc">
<ul>
<li><a href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly">Fund Core Team Developers&nbsp;Directly</a></li>
<li><a href="#donate-to-the-project">Donate to the Project</a><ul>
<li><a href="#paypal">Paypal</a></li>
<li><a href="#liberapay">Liberapay</a></li>
<li><a href="#flattr">Flattr</a></li>
<li><a href="#bitcoin">Bitcoin</a></li>
<li><a href="#cheque">Cheque</a></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div id="donation-usage">
<p>Financial help is needed for different reasons. The annual <a href="https://libregraphicsmeeting.org/">Libre Graphics Meeting</a> is one of these things. It helps to get as many <a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Developers</a> to the conference as possible, so that we can do face-to-face team meetings, plan further development, fix bugs, and write new&nbsp;features.</p>
</div>
<p>If applicable, please specify whether you want to remain anonymous. While we usually don&#8217;t publish the names of donors, this may be considered for exceptional&nbsp;donations.</p>
<p>Many thanks to all our <a href="sponsors.html">sponsors</a>!</p>
<h3 id="paypal">Paypal<a class="headerlink" href="#paypal" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p><a href="https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr?cmd=_donations&amp;business=gimp%40gnome%2eorg&amp;lc=US&amp;item_name=Donation%20to%20GIMP%20Project&amp;item_number=106&amp;currency_code=USD">Donate to gimp@gnome.org</a>, this will notify us, and the <span class="caps">GNOME</span> board, that funds have been donated to the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project. Credit card donations are also accepted via this&nbsp;route.</p>
<form action="https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr" method="post"><input name="cmd" type="hidden" value="_xclick"><input name="business" type="hidden" value="gimp@gnome.org"><input name="item_name" type="hidden" value="Donation to GIMP Project"><input name="item_number" type="hidden" value="106"><input name="no_shipping" type="hidden" value="1"><input alt="Support GIMP" name="submit" src="donate.png" type="image"></form>

<h3 id="liberapay">Liberapay<a class="headerlink" href="#liberapay" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p><a href="https://liberapay.com/GIMP/">Donate to <span class="caps">GIMP</span> on Liberapay</a>. Liberapay is a platform run by a non-profit organization allowing monthly crowdfunding (subscription based). See Wikipedia&#8217;s page on <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liberapay">Liberapay</a>.</p>
<h3 id="flattr">Flattr<a class="headerlink" href="#flattr" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p><a href="https://flattr.com/thing/707850">Donate to <span class="caps">GIMP</span> with Flattr</a>. Flattr is a microdonation system. Users are able to pay a small amount every month (minimum 2 euros) and then click Flattr buttons on sites to share the money they paid among those sites, comparable to an Internet tip jar (for more details see Wikipedia&#8217;s <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flattr">Flattr</a>&nbsp;article).</p>
<p><a class="FlattrButton"
title="Click to Flattr GIMP"
data-flattr-uid="schumaml"
data-flattr-popout="1"
data-flattr-description="GNU Image Manipulation Program (GIMP)"
data-flattr-url="https://www.gimp.org/"
href="https://flattr.com/thing/707850">
<img src='/theme/images/flattr-badge-large.png' alt='Flattr GIMP'/>
</a></p>
<h3 id="bitcoin">Bitcoin<a class="headerlink" href="#bitcoin" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p>Bitcoin (<span class="caps">BTC</span>) is an online digital currency that is based on an open-source, peer-to-peer encryption protocol first described in 2009 by a pseudonymous developer (or developers) Satoshi Nakamoto. Bitcoin is not managed by any government or central authority. Instead, it relies on an Internet-based network (for more details see Wikipedia&#8217;s <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitcoin">Bitcoin</a>&nbsp;article).</p>
<p>Bitcoin address: <a href="bitcoin:1NVMCeoBfTAJQ1qwX2Dx1C8zkcRCQWwHBq?label=GIMP%20Donation">1NVMCeoBfTAJQ1qwX2Dx1C8zkcRCQWwHBq</a></p>
<h3 id="cheque">Cheque<a class="headerlink" href="#cheque" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p>Cheque, made payable to the <a href="https://www.gnome.org/"><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation</a>, and sent&nbsp;to:</p>
<p><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation
 #117
 21 Orinda Way Ste. C
 Orinda, <span class="caps">CA</span> 94563
 <span class="caps">USA</span></p>
<p>with a cover-letter (or a note in the &#8220;memo&#8221; field) saying it is for the <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;project.</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

            <div class="column full">
                <h1>Donate</h1>
                
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <section class='page_content'>
        <div class='container'>
            <div class='row clearfix'>
                <div class='column full'>
                    <p>Donating money to the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project is easy and important as it allows the
project&nbsp;sustainability.</p>
<h2 id="fund-core-team-developers-directly">Fund Core Team Developers Directly<a class="headerlink" href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>While we don&#8217;t raise funds to sponsor development as an organization yet, we encourage contributor&nbsp;fundraisers:</p>
<p class='buttons'>
  <a href="https://www.patreon.com/pippin">
    <span class='donate-button'>
      Fund Øyvind Kolås<sup>1</sup><br/>
      <strong><span class="caps">GEGL</span> development</strong>
    </span>
  </a>
  <a href="https://www.patreon.com/zemarmot">
    <span class='donate-button'>
      Fund ZeMarmot<sup>2</sup><br/>
      <strong><span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;development</strong>
    </span>
  </a>
</p>

<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Øyvind Kolås</strong> <a href="https://www.patreon.com/pippin">raises funds</a> for his work on <a href="http://gegl.org/"><span class="caps">GEGL</span></a>, <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&#8217;s new sophisticated image processing core. This work is crucial to implement features such as non-destructive editing in <span class="caps">GIMP</span>, including features known as adjustment layers and layer effects in similar software. Øyvind is the <span class="caps">GEGL</span> maintainer and its primary developer who has been working on it since&nbsp;mid-2000s.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Aryeom and Jehan</strong> <a href="https://www.patreon.com/zemarmot">raise funds</a> for <span class="caps">GIMP</span> development and a <span class="caps">GIMP</span>-powered animated movie: <strong>ZeMarmot</strong> (Libre Art, Creative Commons by-sa 4.0 licenses). The funds allow developing features for professional graphics usage and keeping <span class="caps">GIMP</span> bug-free. Jehan is a <span class="caps">GIMP</span> maintainer and has been one of its most active contributors since 2012, while Aryeom designs and tests features in production ever since, in a professional&nbsp;context.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="donate-to-the-project">Donate to the Project<a class="headerlink" href="#donate-to-the-project" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h2>
<p>The <a href="https://www.gnome.org/"><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation</a> has graciously agreed to act as fiscal agents for us. Contributions to the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project can be made by donating to the <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation and specifying the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project as the recipient. The <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation is a tax-exempt, non-profit 501(c)(3) organization and all donations are tax-deductible in the <span class="caps">USA</span>.</p>
<p>So far <strong>donation through <span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation can only be used for community needs</strong> (conferences, developer meetings… see <a href="#donation-usage">below</a>) and material renewal. <a href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly">If you would rather fund paid development, favour Core Team developer funding above</a>.</p>
<p>You can choose from several options to support <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;financially:</p>
<div class="toc">
<ul>
<li><a href="#fund-core-team-developers-directly">Fund Core Team Developers&nbsp;Directly</a></li>
<li><a href="#donate-to-the-project">Donate to the Project</a><ul>
<li><a href="#paypal">Paypal</a></li>
<li><a href="#liberapay">Liberapay</a></li>
<li><a href="#flattr">Flattr</a></li>
<li><a href="#bitcoin">Bitcoin</a></li>
<li><a href="#cheque">Cheque</a></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div id="donation-usage">
<p>Financial help is needed for different reasons. The annual <a href="https://libregraphicsmeeting.org/">Libre Graphics Meeting</a> is one of these things. It helps to get as many <a href="https://www.gimp.org/about/authors.html"><span class="caps">GIMP</span> Developers</a> to the conference as possible, so that we can do face-to-face team meetings, plan further development, fix bugs, and write new&nbsp;features.</p>
</div>
<p>If applicable, please specify whether you want to remain anonymous. While we usually don&#8217;t publish the names of donors, this may be considered for exceptional&nbsp;donations.</p>
<p>Many thanks to all our <a href="sponsors.html">sponsors</a>!</p>
<h3 id="paypal">Paypal<a class="headerlink" href="#paypal" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p><a href="https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr?cmd=_donations&amp;business=gimp%40gnome%2eorg&amp;lc=US&amp;item_name=Donation%20to%20GIMP%20Project&amp;item_number=106&amp;currency_code=USD">Donate to gimp@gnome.org</a>, this will notify us, and the <span class="caps">GNOME</span> board, that funds have been donated to the <span class="caps">GIMP</span> project. Credit card donations are also accepted via this&nbsp;route.</p>
<form action="https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr" method="post"><input name="cmd" type="hidden" value="_xclick"><input name="business" type="hidden" value="gimp@gnome.org"><input name="item_name" type="hidden" value="Donation to GIMP Project"><input name="item_number" type="hidden" value="106"><input name="no_shipping" type="hidden" value="1"><input alt="Support GIMP" name="submit" src="donate.png" type="image"></form>

<h3 id="liberapay">Liberapay<a class="headerlink" href="#liberapay" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p><a href="https://liberapay.com/GIMP/">Donate to <span class="caps">GIMP</span> on Liberapay</a>. Liberapay is a platform run by a non-profit organization allowing monthly crowdfunding (subscription based). See Wikipedia&#8217;s page on <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liberapay">Liberapay</a>.</p>
<h3 id="flattr">Flattr<a class="headerlink" href="#flattr" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p><a href="https://flattr.com/thing/707850">Donate to <span class="caps">GIMP</span> with Flattr</a>. Flattr is a microdonation system. Users are able to pay a small amount every month (minimum 2 euros) and then click Flattr buttons on sites to share the money they paid among those sites, comparable to an Internet tip jar (for more details see Wikipedia&#8217;s <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flattr">Flattr</a>&nbsp;article).</p>
<p><a class="FlattrButton"
title="Click to Flattr GIMP"
data-flattr-uid="schumaml"
data-flattr-popout="1"
data-flattr-description="GNU Image Manipulation Program (GIMP)"
data-flattr-url="https://www.gimp.org/"
href="https://flattr.com/thing/707850">
<img src='/theme/images/flattr-badge-large.png' alt='Flattr GIMP'/>
</a></p>
<h3 id="bitcoin">Bitcoin<a class="headerlink" href="#bitcoin" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p>Bitcoin (<span class="caps">BTC</span>) is an online digital currency that is based on an open-source, peer-to-peer encryption protocol first described in 2009 by a pseudonymous developer (or developers) Satoshi Nakamoto. Bitcoin is not managed by any government or central authority. Instead, it relies on an Internet-based network (for more details see Wikipedia&#8217;s <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitcoin">Bitcoin</a>&nbsp;article).</p>
<p>Bitcoin address: <a href="bitcoin:1NVMCeoBfTAJQ1qwX2Dx1C8zkcRCQWwHBq?label=GIMP%20Donation">1NVMCeoBfTAJQ1qwX2Dx1C8zkcRCQWwHBq</a></p>
<h3 id="cheque">Cheque<a class="headerlink" href="#cheque" title="Permanent link">&para;</a></h3>
<p>Cheque, made payable to the <a href="https://www.gnome.org/"><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation</a>, and sent&nbsp;to:</p>
<p><span class="caps">GNOME</span> Foundation
 #117
 21 Orinda Way Ste. C
 Orinda, <span class="caps">CA</span> 94563
 <span class="caps">USA</span></p>
<p>with a cover-letter (or a note in the &#8220;memo&#8221; field) saying it is for the <span class="caps">GIMP</span>&nbsp;project.</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>
